title: Weekend AI No-code Game Jam – make a mobile game, win $200
author: tedwatson1234
selftext:
We just launched **#PaletAIJam** for anyone who’s ever wanted to create a game without coding:

• **Grand Prize $200** • 2× $50 runners-up  
• Winners featured in the PaletAI **Home-feed** for a week  
• **Winner = most in-app likes** (so share your link everywhere!)

**How:**

1. Download PaletAI (free, iOS, US only)
2. Create & publish a game
3. Post your game link on X/Twitter with **#PaletAIJam** \+ follow @**PaletAIApp**

**Deadline Sun July 20 @ 11:59 PM PT**  
Details → [**https://promptjam.carrd.co/**](https://promptjam.carrd.co/)

No code required—just creativity. Hope to see your entry!
